title: Shapley layer weights on complementary subsets
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $t$ be a natural number with $t\le |J|$. Using the layer weight $w(n,k)=1/((n+1)\binom{n}{k})$, the sum of $w(n,t+|U|)$ over all subsets $U$ of the complement of $J$ equals $w(|J|,t)$.
hypotheses_covered: J is a finite subset of the n coordinates
